Illegal aliens are being vetted after their arrest, including juveniles. No releases: the border is closed.

PACKAGE CHECK: COCAINE AND METH SEIZED!
 
Several packages ended up on the naughty list this holiday season. In Tampa, FL, a USBP K9 team detected suspicious parcels during inspections at a parcel facility. Agents seized approximately 22 pounds of cocaine and nearly 2 pounds of methamphetamine. 
 
We remain vigilant in stopping illegal narcotics from reaching our communities.

tweets.text:
USBP agents stopped a black sedan in San Clemente, CA, where a K9 alert led to the discovery of 43 packages of narcotics inside a duffel bag.
 
🔺 19 packages of fentanyl weighing 25 lbs.
🔺 24 packages of heroin weighing 31 lbs.
 
The U.S. citizen driver was turned over to the DEA for prosecution, and the passenger, who overstayed his visa, is pending deportation and visa cancellation. Enforcement efforts continue to deliver real results, effectively removing dangerous drugs and criminals from our communities.

@cbpgov @dhsgov @usbpchiefsdc
